sections.title: Chorus: "The Winner Takes It All"
sections.character: Grand, dramatic climax with resonant pedal

annotations.title: Driving Broken Chord Accompaniment
annotations.instruction: Keep the right hand wrist relaxed while maintaining steady 8th-note pulsation. The thumb and index fingers articulate inner harmony while the pinky voices outer top lines.
annotations.wristGuidance: Slight vertical cushioning at each downbeat keeps the tempo solid and fluid.

annotations.title: Chorus Voicing & Climax Projection
annotations.instruction: Bring out the top singing melody (C5, A4) with full forearm weight while cushioning the lower chord tones.
annotations.pedalGuidance: Change pedal promptly on beat 1 of every measure to prevent muddy dissonance.
